lines.zh: 我拖着结晶化的腿走过去。
lines.en: I drag my crystallized leg along.
I leave scratches where I walk.
Each step is heavy, and pauses.

lines.zh: 我的结晶边角刮着空气。
lines.en: My crystal edges scrape the air.
I turn slowly. Don't panic.
I come from the rubble.
I come with no sound.
My arms hang like pillars.
I walk on, crooked.
I shove aside whatever blocks me.
I stand and my body glints.
My crystal grows slowly.
I stand still, hard as stone.
My eyes are sunk in stone.
I wait for you to come too close.
I slowly set my head straight.
Nothing bleeds from me.

lines.zh: 我像一尊走错了地方的石像。
lines.en: I look like a statue in the wrong place.
Not one of my knuckles moved.
I listen to the ground's shaking.
I turn my crystal face to you.
I stare at you, eyes bright.
My edge tips your way.
My weight presses into my feet.

lines.zh: 我在估你打得动我几下。
lines.en: I am estimating how many hits you can land.

lines.zh: 我的结晶掉了一点碎屑。
lines.en: A little crystal dust falls.

lines.zh: 我抬起结晶手臂，指向你。
lines.en: I lift a crystal arm and point it at you.
My light flashes across you.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛里映出你的轮廓。
lines.en: Your outline reflects in my eyes.
I turn my shoulders to you, slowly.
A chunk breaks off me.

lines.zh: 碎屑掉了一地，我仍站着。
lines.en: Shards litter the ground; I'm still standing.
A crack runs through my crystal.
I let out not a sound.
I turn my head slowly.
I shake the chips off.
I press the crack.
I lower my weight again.
I stare at you without expression.
I glance, and still do not move.
Iron means little to me.
A caster's crystal, cold as iron.
Food does not make me move.
I crush it with a crystal hand.
The crystal slowly turns toward you.
It cracks under my foot.

lines.zh: 我这块结晶，法术还没散。
lines.en: This crystal of mine still holds its spell.
My edge catches you.
Chips fly off.
We make a hard, ringing clack.
You are pushed back three blocks.

lines.zh: 我的结晶上多了一道白痕。
lines.en: A white mark appears on my crystal.

lines.zh: 我的手肘撞在你的肋骨上。
lines.en: My elbow hits your ribs.
We both step back after the clash.

lines.zh: 结晶的棱角，会记住你的体温。
lines.en: My crystal edges will remember your warmth.
Two crystal forms stand side by side.
Our edges rest together.
We glint at the same moment.

lines.zh: 它们之间一点声音都没有。
lines.en: Not a sound passes between them.

lines.zh: 我们的结晶像要长到一起。
lines.en: Our crystals seem about to join.

lines.zh: 我们一起朝同一个方向倾。
lines.en: We lean the same way.
It touches me with its edge.

lines.zh: 我们一起走到更暗的地方。
lines.en: We walk to somewhere darker.
Neither of us opens a mouth.
We stand in silence.
I grab it and it cracks.
I pinch it in crystal fingers.
I wedge it into a crack in my body.
I hold it to the light.
I drag it, heavy.
I set it down slowly.

lines.zh: 我把它举到眼前，很认真。
lines.en: I hold it up and study it.
I hold it in both hands.
I turn my whole body.
My crystal starts to glow.
I walk to your position.
I begin moving faster.
My crystal fingers have opened.
You count as an enemy.
My weight leans forward.
I am no longer staying put.
I have chosen a target.
My edges face you.
I raise both hands slowly.
This patch of ground is mine.

lines.zh: 你身上的源石味，我记住了。
lines.en: I've memorized the originium on your breath.
I begin coming this way.
You go around a stone; I go through.
My footsteps are heavy.
You hide behind a slope; I climb it.
I am two blocks at your flank.
No hurry; I outlast you.
My crystal grows brighter.

lines.zh: 你听见石头刮地的声音。
lines.en: You hear stone scraping earth.
I spiral inward on you.
Where you walk, the ground cracks.
I keep this pace.
You are looking back more often.
I herd you toward the wall.
Only one block between us.
Your armor will not last long.
I never leave this line.
You run; I merely walk.

lines.zh: 我的结晶边缘一直朝你。
lines.en: My crystal edge stays on you.

lines.zh: 我的结晶拳砸在你胸口。
lines.en: My crystal fist slams your chest.
One arm sweeps your guard aside.
I shoulder into your chest.
My foot grinds down on yours.
I bring my hand down, heavy.
You are knocked back several blocks.

lines.zh: 我的边角割开你的袖子。
lines.en: My edge slices your sleeve.
I barely change posture.
You block once and your arm numbs.

lines.zh: 晶体关节一响，我挥出去。
lines.en: My crystal joints crack, and I swing.
I press you onto stone.
I raise my hand and let it fall.
Chips bounce off you.
You pull back; I do not chase.

lines.zh: 我的重量压得你站不稳。
lines.en: My weight makes you unsteady.
You hear stone hit stone.
My foot grinds beside yours.
I pound my fist on your shield.
My edge drags across your leg.

lines.zh: 你被我的重量推得后退。
lines.en: My weight pushes you back.
A crystal mass appears on the ground.
I stand up out of the rubble.
The color of this ground has changed.
My crystal shows first.

lines.zh: 你听见石头摩擦的声音。
lines.en: You hear stone grinding.
I begin walking this area.
There is dust in the air.

lines.zh: 一个硬东西站在了路上。
lines.en: Something hard stands in the road.
I am squeezed up out of the soil.
My shadow is wide and low.
I appeared without a greeting.

lines.zh: 你听见一声很闷的碰撞。
lines.en: You hear a muffled impact.

lines.zh: 火烧不掉石头，只让它发烫。
lines.en: Fire cannot burn stone, only heat it.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下，落地时裂了几道。
lines.en: I fall from a height and crack on landing.
Water seeps into my cracks and I sink.

lines.zh: 爆风把我震得碎屑四飞。
lines.en: The blast throws chips off me.

lines.zh: 一支箭弹开，只留下一道白点。
lines.en: An arrow bounces off, leaving a white mark.

lines.zh: 那股力量钻进了我的裂缝。
lines.en: That force works into my cracks.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的结晶跑了一遍。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my crystal.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我整块掉下去。
lines.en: The ground is gone and I drop whole.
